row.problem_statement:
LongestCommonSubsequence: incorrect results and IndexError

```
In [1]: from strsimpy.longest_common_subsequence import LongestCommonSubsequence

In [2]: lcs = LongestCommonSubsequence()

In [3]: lcs.length('AGCAT', 'GAC')
IndexError: list index out of range

In [4]: lcs.length('上海', '上海市')
IndexError: list index out of range
```

I'm trying to use the LongestCommonSubsequence class to find the length of the longest common subsequence between two strings, but it's throwing an IndexError. 

The error occurs when trying to access elements in the matrix that are out of bounds. This happens with any pair of strings I try to compare.

Additionally, when I try to use the distance method, it also fails because it relies on the length method:

```
In [5]: lcs.distance('上海', '上海市')
IndexError: list index out of range
```

This issue also affects the MetricLCS class which depends on LongestCommonSubsequence.
